label: Background singularity theorems (trapped surface / energy conditions imply geodesic incompleteness)
statement_exact: Classical singularity theorems: a spacetime containing a trapped surface (Penrose 1965) or satisfying suitable energy and causality conditions with a closed or collapsing region (Hawking-Penrose 1970) must be null/timelike geodesically incomplete.
assumptions: Einstein's equations with suitable energy conditions
Causality/global-hyperbolicity hypotheses as in the original theorems
Exact statements not extracted from the primary texts in this run
scope_caveats: BACKGROUND ONLY: neither theorem asserts or refutes cosmic censorship; they establish incompleteness under hypotheses.
SRC-010 and SRC-012 are metadata-only in this ledger; exact statements were not machine-read.

The trapped-surface-to-incompleteness statement is quoted in the ledger only through the primary follow-up SRC-041 conference abstract ('a theorem which asserts that a spacetime containing such a surface must come to an end').
does_not_imply: Does not imply WCC or SCC.
Does not locate singularities relative to I+.
unresolved: Exact theorem statements/hypotheses from Penrose 1965 and Hawking-Penrose 1970 (publisher paywalled).
falsifiers: Find a counterexample to the classical theorems (none known) or show the hypotheses fail in the intended applications.
next_action: Page-check the two originals if library access becomes available.

label: C^0-inextendibility methods in cosmological and warped-product models (outside the four classes)
statement_exact: Low-regularity inextendibility methods extend beyond Schwarzschild: the maximal analytic Kasner spacetime, classes of FLRW spacetimes (including axisymmetric extensions of earlier results), and a class of warped-product black-hole spacetimes with compact homogeneous fibres and a curvature singularity are C^0-inextendible.
assumptions: Exact/analytic model spacetimes or stated symmetry classes
Warped-product class: closed, connected, homogeneous, orientable fibre; Kretschmann divergence as r->0
genericity: Model-class results; not generic-data statements for the four frozen classes.
scope_caveats: Outside the four frozen classes; recorded as method transfer and non-AF context only.
SRC-007 is a master's thesis (not peer-reviewed); SRC-008 and SRC-009 are preprints.
does_not_imply: Does not imply C^0 SCC for asymptotically flat vacuum data.
Does not transfer to Kerr interiors, where the opposite (C^0 extendibility) is established.
unresolved: Whether the warped-product hypotheses cover any physically relevant AF model.
falsifiers: Construct a continuous extension in one of the stated model classes, or show the warp-product assumptions exclude the claimed class.
next_action: Keep as method-transfer evidence in the C0 dossier's informing section.
